Sandbox_CharacterCreationCustomizer_QOL_: Shows each major skill's starting level after applying the profession, traits, and Customizer settings.
Shows each skill's effective XP multiplier after level scaling, learner traits, Crafty, Pacifist, and MultiplierConfig are applied.
Shows the configured Points to Spend value beside each profession's name.
Sandbox_CharacterCreationCustomizer_Init: Adds or removes levels from this skill at character creation. Values range from -10 to 10.
Sandbox_CharacterCreationCustomizer_Cost: Changes the cost of this option.
Sandbox_CharacterCreationCustomizer_Trai: Makes this trait unavailable during character creation.
Makes this profession-only trait available for purchase during character creation.
Changes how many points you spend or gain when selecting this trait.
Sandbox_CharacterCreationCustomizer_Prof: Hides this profession during character creation.
Changes how many points you gain or spend when selecting this profession.
Sandbox_CharacterCreationCustomizer_Gran: Replaces the traits this profession grants. Enter trait names separated by commas.
Adds these items when this profession is selected. Enter full item types, such as Base.ItemName, separated by commas.
